dedupe_keys.name: traffic loads and counting sites on slovenian state roads drsi

description: The Slovenian Infrastructure Agency publishes on the national open data portal the traffic loads on the state road network since 1997. The collection holds yearly tables (XLS and XLSX) from 1997 and maps (PDF) from 2002 of annual average daily traffic (PLDP), the average number of motor vehicles passing a counting site in both directions in 24 hours, derived from automatic traffic counters across Slovenia and manual counts; the latest files are for 2024. A companion dataset lists the automatic and manual counting sites of each year since 2005 as tables and maps, located by chainage on the road section in the D48 coordinate system and from 2020 in D96/TM. The current state of traffic counters is also offered as a real-time dataset on the national access point for traffic data (NAP). Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0. Access is free of charge. Caveats: tables and maps are separate files per year, older years are in the old coordinate system, and the pages are in Slovenian. Coverage is Slovenian motorways and state roads. It supports network flow modelling, capacity planning and exposure analysis of the road network; related records are the Luxembourg national road traffic counts and the Croatian transport registers.
